# Load packages

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(RIdeogram)
library(patchwork)
library(gggenes)
library(ggfittext)
library(ggforce)
library(plotly)
library(gggenes)
library(stringr)
```


# Load data

```{r}
genome <- read_tsv("../data/Ensembl/mart_export.txt")
head(genome)

hpa_data_v24 <- read_csv("../data/HPA v.24/hpa_data_v24.csv")
head(hpa_data_v24)

hpa_data_v25 <- read_csv("../data/HPA v.25/hpa_evidence_v25.csv")
head(hpa_data_v25)
```

# Prepare genome wide data

```{r}
data(human_karyotype, package="RIdeogram")

genome |> distinct(`Chromosome/scaffold name`) |>
  arrange(`Chromosome/scaffold name`)

genome |> 
  filter(`Chromosome/scaffold name` %in% c(1:22, "X", "Y")) |>
  distinct(`Gene type`, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  arrange(`Gene type`) |>
  select(`Gene type`, `Chromosome/scaffold name`)

hpa_genome_raw <- genome |>
  select(Gene = `Gene stable ID`, Start = `Gene start (bp)`, End = `Gene end (bp)`, Chromosome = `Chromosome/scaffold name`, Strand = `Strand`, `Gene type`) |>
  filter(Chromosome %in% c(1:22, "X", "Y"))

hpa_genome_raw |> distinct(Chromosome) |> arrange(Chromosome)

hpa_genome <- hpa_data_v25 |>
  select(Gene = Ensembl,  `HPA evidence`) |>
  distinct(Gene, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  right_join(hpa_genome_raw, by = "Gene") |>
  distinct(Gene, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  na.omit() |> # 20,125 genes? Where did the 20,162 - 37 genes go?
  # Replace No evidence with 0 and all other values with 1
  mutate(`HPA evidence` = case_when(`HPA evidence` == "Evidence at protein level" ~ 1,
                                    `HPA evidence` == "Evidence at transcript level" ~ 0.5,
                                    `HPA evidence` == "No human protein/transcript evidence" ~ 0)) |>
  arrange(Gene)
```

# Plots

## RIdeogram plot of HPA evidence distribution

```{r}
svg_file <- ideogram(karyotype = human_karyotype, 
                     overlaid = hpa_genome |> 
                       rename(Value = `HPA evidence`) |> 
                       select(Chr = Chromosome, Start, End, Value) |> 
                       arrange(Chr, Start),
                     output = "chromosome.svg")

convertSVG("chromosome.svg", device = "png")

convertSVG(svg_file, file = "hpa_evidence")

svg2png(svg = svg_file)
```

```{r}
svg_file <- ideogram(karyotype = human_karyotype, 
                     overlaid = hpa_genome |> 
                       rename(Value = `HPA evidence`) |> 
                       select(Chr = Chromosome, Start, End, Value) |> 
                       arrange(Chr, Start),
                     colorset1 = c("firebrick", "darkorange", "darkgreen"), # Custom colors for HPA evidence categories
                     output = "chromosome.svg")

svg2pdf("chromosome.svg", width= 10, height = 14, file = "chromosomal_hpa_evidence.pdf")
svg2png("chromosome.svg", width = 10, height = 14, file = "chromosomal_hpa_evidence.png")
```

```{r}
library(rsvg)

# Generate SVG file
svg_path <- "chromosome.svg"
ideogram(
  karyotype = human_karyotype, 
  overlaid = hpa_genome |> 
    rename(Value = `HPA evidence`) |> 
    select(Chr = Chromosome, Start, End, Value) |> 
    arrange(Chr, Start),
  colorset1 = c("firebrick", "darkorange", "darkgreen"),
  output = svg_path
)

# Convert SVG → PDF
rsvg_pdf(svg_path, file = "chromosomal_hpa_evidence.pdf", width = 10, height = 14)

# Convert SVG → PNG
rsvg_png(svg_path, file = "chromosomal_hpa_evidence.png", width = 10 * 72, height = 14 * 72) 
# width/height in rsvg_png are in pixels
```

## Stacked bar plot of HPA evidence distribution by chromosome

```{r}
# Define chromosome order
chrom_order <- c(as.character(1:22), "X", "Y")

# Custom colors for HPA evidence categories
custom_colors <- c(
  "Evidence at protein level" = "darkgreen",     # blue
  "Evidence at transcript level" = "darkorange",  # orange
  "No human protein/transcript evidence" = "firebrick"  # red
)

# Plot
chromosomal_bar_percentage <- hpa_data_v25 %>%
  inner_join(hpa_data_v24 |> select(Ensembl, Chromosome), by = "Ensembl") %>%
  select(Ensembl, Chromosome, `HPA evidence`) %>%
  distinct(Ensembl, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  filter(!Chromosome %in% c("MT", "Unmapped")) %>%
  mutate(Chromosome = factor(Chromosome, levels = chrom_order)) %>%
  count(Chromosome, `HPA evidence`) %>%
  group_by(Chromosome) %>%
  mutate(percentage = n / sum(n) * 100) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Chromosome, y = percentage, fill = `HPA evidence`)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack", color = "black", size = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = custom_colors) +  # 👈 custom colors applied here
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05)), labels = scales::percent_format(scale = 1)) +
  labs(
    x = "Chromosome",
    y = "Percentage of genes",
    fill = "HPA Evidence",
    title = "Distribution of HPA Evidence Categories by Chromosome"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text.x.top = element_blank()
  ) +
  coord_flip()

chromosomal_bar_percentage

ggsave("Stacked bar plot HPA evidence distribution v.25.pdf", width = 7, height = 14, dpi = 300, path = "../plots/pdf/Figure 5")
ggsave("Stacked bar plot HPA evidence distribution v.25.png", width = 7, height = 14, dpi = 300, path = "../plots/png/Figure 5")
```

```{r}
add_segments <- function(df, 
                         chr_col = "Chromosome", 
                         start_col = "Start", 
                         genes_per_segment = 10,
                         prefix = "chr") {
  chr_sym <- sym(chr_col)
  start_sym <- sym(start_col)

  df %>%
    arrange(!!chr_sym, !!start_sym) %>%
    group_by(!!chr_sym) %>%
    mutate(
      segment = paste0(prefix, !!chr_sym, "_part_", ceiling(row_number() / genes_per_segment))
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
}

genes_per_segment <- 20
chromosome <- "1"


# Prepare the data
df <- hpa_genome %>%
  select(-`HPA evidence`) %>%
  # Add HPA evidence
  inner_join(hpa_data_v25 %>% 
               distinct(Ensembl, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
               select(Gene = Ensembl, `HPA evidence`), 
             by = "Gene") %>%
  # Add gene symbols
  inner_join(hpa_data_v24 %>% 
               select(Gene = Ensembl, Gene_symbol = Gene), 
             by = "Gene") %>%
  filter(Chromosome == chromosome) %>%
  mutate(molecule = paste0("chr", Chromosome)) %>%
  rename(start = Start, end = End, orientation = Strand, gene = Gene) %>%
  mutate(
    strand = ifelse(orientation == 1, "forward", "reverse"),
    orientation = ifelse(orientation == -1, 0, orientation)
  ) %>%
  add_segments(chr_col = "molecule", start_col = "start", genes_per_segment = genes_per_segment) %>%
  mutate(segment = factor(segment, 
                          levels = unique(segment[order(as.numeric(str_extract(segment, "\\d+$")))]))
         ) |>
  # Filter for the 100 gene with the lowest start
  filter(!is.na(start) & !is.na(end)) %>%
  arrange(start) %>%
  slice_head(n = 100)

# HPA evidence plot
# your custom palette
custom_colors <- c(
  "Evidence at protein level"            = "darkgreen",
  "Evidence at transcript level"         = "darkorange",
  "No human protein/transcript evidence" = "firebrick"
)

hpa_plot <- df %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    xmin     = start,
    xmax     = end,
    y        = segment,
    fill     = `HPA evidence`,
    label    = Gene_symbol,
    forward  = orientation
  )) +
  geom_gene_arrow() +
  geom_gene_label(align = "left") +
  facet_wrap(~ segment, scales = "free", ncol = 1) +
  theme_genes() +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name   = "HPA evidence",
    values = custom_colors,
    na.value = "grey80"
  )

hpa_plot

ggsave("hpa_chr1_100_relative_.pdf", hpa_plot, width = 20, height = 7, dpi = 300, path = "../plots/pdf/Figure 5")
ggsave("hpa_chr1_100_relative_.png", hpa_plot, width = 20, height = 7, dpi = 300, path = "../plots/png/Figure 5")

ggsave("hpa_chr1_100_relative_poster.pdf", hpa_plot, width = 18, height = 5, dpi = 300, path = "../plots/pdf/Figure 5")
```

```{r}
chromosome <- "1"

# Prepare initial data
df <- hpa_genome %>%
  select(-`HPA evidence`) %>%
  inner_join(hpa_data_v25 %>% 
               distinct(Ensembl, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
               select(Gene = Ensembl, `HPA evidence`), 
             by = "Gene") %>%
  inner_join(hpa_data_v24 %>% 
               select(Gene = Ensembl, Gene_symbol = Gene), 
             by = "Gene") %>%
  filter(Chromosome == chromosome) %>%
  mutate(molecule = paste0("chr", Chromosome)) %>%
  rename(start = Start, end = End, orientation = Strand, gene = Gene) %>%
  mutate(
    strand = ifelse(orientation == 1, "forward", "reverse"),
    orientation = ifelse(orientation == -1, 0, orientation)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(start) & !is.na(end)) %>%
  arrange(start) %>%
  slice_head(n = 100)

# Compute segment intervals based on genomic range
min_start <- min(df$start, na.rm = TRUE)
max_end   <- max(df$end, na.rm = TRUE)

# Divide the range evenly into 5 segments
segment_breaks <- seq(min_start, max_end, length.out = 6)  # creates 5 segments (6 breakpoints)

# Assign genes to these segments based on their start position
df <- df %>%
  mutate(segment = cut(
    start,
    breaks = segment_breaks,
    labels = paste0("segment_", 1:5),
    include.lowest = TRUE
  ))

# Custom palette
custom_colors <- c(
  "Evidence at protein level"            = "darkgreen",
  "Evidence at transcript level"         = "darkorange",
  "No human protein/transcript evidence" = "firebrick"
)

# Plotting
hpa_plot <- df %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    xmin     = start,
    xmax     = end,
    y        = segment,
    fill     = `HPA evidence`,
    label    = Gene_symbol,
    forward  = orientation
  )) +
  geom_gene_arrow() +
  geom_gene_label(align = "left") +
  facet_wrap(~ segment, scales = "free", ncol = 1) +
  theme_genes() +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name   = "HPA evidence",
    values = custom_colors,
    na.value = "grey80"
  )

# Display plot
hpa_plot

# Save plot
ggsave("hpa_chr1_100_relative_segments.pdf", hpa_plot, width = 30, height = 7, dpi = 300, path = "../plots/pdf/Figure 5")
ggsave("hpa_chr1_100_relative_segments.png", hpa_plot, width = 30, height = 7, dpi = 300, path = "../plots/png/Figure 5")

```
